missionPremise: Operator ruling 2026-08-18 / 2026-08-19 (OPS-16 amendments A-018, A-019): the County Manifest must be a LIVE FEED, not a four-day-old snapshot, and the console exists so defects are spotted rather than hand-found. There are THREE layers, not two, and all three disagree independently: WRITTEN (atoms in the store), SCORED (county_facet_coverage via GET /api/county-ledger), SERVED (what Smart Site shows a human). The divergences between them ARE the defect list. This lane continues SS-W6 inside apps/command-center/** only.
completionPredicate: On the County Manifest panel a stranger can (a) read WRITTEN, SCORED and SERVED side by side for the same county and rail, with each layer carrying its own origin, its own timestamp and its own denominator, and with no cross-layer arithmetic anywhere; (b) find the subtabs without being told where they are, and land on one directly from a URL; (c) see the ledger's staleness as an alarm that names what it invalidates, not a banner; (d) see the three dead indicators either derived from live payload or deleted, with the deletion stated on screen; (e) read every rail against its own reachable ceiling rather than against 254. Suite green, PR open against main, not merged, not deployed.
scopeBasis: File ownership is apps/command-center/** only; four other lanes are running in this repo. The serving-sweep ENDPOINT is SS-W7 (legacy-design-tools/cortex-api) and the sweep DATA is P-43 (hauska-engine); neither is attempted here. The county_facet_coverage recompute lives in hauska-engine. No route, no proxy allowlist rule (root api/spine.ts) and no server code is touched: both new reads are GETs, which the proxy already allows for the cortex and retrieval segments.

designDecisions: THIRD SUBTAB 'Three layers' renders WRITTEN | SCORED | SERVED side by side per county per rail. Nothing is averaged; the only arithmetic across layers is the scored-vs-served gap in points, which is legal because both are percentages of parcels. Written counts are compared as presence-vs-zero only.
A layer with no instrument for a cell renders as NOT MEASURED naming the instrument's coverage set, never as zero (DEV_PROCESS 1.3, 3.3).

STALENESS becomes an alarm bar present on every subtab, carrying the age, the consequence sentence, and two derived checks: (1) evidence horizon — any observation the console can see that POSTDATES computedAt; (2) declared work horizon — a small, explicitly hand-declared, dated list of landed work with its doc_repo artifact path, of which the L26 footprint claim is the worked example. The declared list is rendered as declared-upstream provenance so it can never pass for a measurement.

SUBTAB AFFORDANCE: role=tablist/tab segmented control with visible borders, per-tab status badges, keyboard arrows, and a URL param (#panel=county-manifest&view=three-layer) so a subtab is linkable and survives reload.

LIVE FEED: the ledger re-reads on an interval while the panel is open, with the re-read verdict from SS-W6 preserved. A re-read that does not move computedAt continues to be reported as upstream staleness, never as a refresh. The written probe is NOT put on the interval — it is slow and flaky (W8-F7) and one 240s hang would freeze the feed.
The sweep endpoint is auto-probed once when the SERVED layer is first needed, so the operator does not have to find a button; the artifact origin stays a labelled fallback.

risksAndMitigations.risk: A new declared list (work horizon) is exactly the hand-declared rot class this lane is deleting elsewhere.
risksAndMitigations.mitigation: it is rendered as declared-upstream, carries a per-entry doc_repo artifact path and a declaredAt, and sits beside two derived checks that need no declaration. The wells half of the same source line is NOT declared because the rrc-wells capability probe and standing memory contradict it.

risksAndMitigations.risk: An interval re-read could hammer the endpoint or leak a timer.
risksAndMitigations.mitigation: 60s floor, cleared on unmount, toggleable, and the read path is the single readLedger() SS-W6 already established.

risksAndMitigations.risk: Rendering an artifact as if it were live.
risksAndMitigations.mitigation: origin labelling is retained from SS-W6 for the sweep and reused for the written layer; both carry locator + HTTP status + notServedReason.
